title: Know2Guess：面向大语言模型知识边界评估的污染感知多区域基准
summary: 提出一个污染感知的多区域基准，用于评估大语言模型从可回答知识到预期未知的过渡。包含1200个条目、五个领域、明确的弃权预期和污染风险元数据。评估了FLAN-T5、Qwen2.5-Instruct和Llama-3-Instruct模型，发现强指令调优模型在选择性弃权方面表现更好，但整体校准仍较差。
summary_en: A contamination-aware multi-zone benchmark for evaluating LLMs' transition from answerable knowledge to expected unknowns. Contains 1,200 items across five domains with explicit abstention expectations and contamination metadata. Evaluations show stronger instruction-tuned models exhibit selective but incomplete abstention, while calibration remains poor.
